title: A manual Website Opportunities build of a quickstart-first revision keeps its action open until the site's fill ends, instead of closing it and killing the fill
steps: S1: Start a disposable Postgres and set TEST_DATABASE_URL.
S2: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run`.
S3: Read the pass/fail counts and the tests named below.
expect: A manual quickstart-first action stays queued while the fill runs, completes when it applies and fails with SITE_FILL_FAILED when it fails, without QA retry or hand-off.
A manual action whose site access is lost or whose site is deleted stops instead of waiting for the timeout.
A manual legacy action still completes as soon as its site is built; automatic actions are unchanged.
evidence: Dev, 23/10/2026: a manual build of a quickstart-first WordPress revision ended its action completed 5 seconds after the site build; one second later the site's fill failed with QUICKSTART_ACTION_CLOSED because the fill writes only while its action is queued.
fence: The demo runner's handling of non-automatic actions; the fill guard quickstartActionOpen and the automatic path are unchanged

tests: a manual quickstart-first build keeps its action open until the fill applies, then stops without QA or hand-off
a manual quickstart-first build whose fill fails ends SITE_FILL_FAILED
a manual Retry resumes the failed fill once, waits for it and completes without hand-off
a manual Retry that lost site access stops before resuming the fill
a manual quickstart-first build whose site is deleted while its fill runs stops
a manual legacy build still completes as soon as its site is built
